body.x: ChoisTechnology(representative Soon-pil Choi, www.choistec.com), known more for X-point, boasted 'XPM145' RF wireless presenter.'XPM145' is not the only functional presentation laser pointer, but also office item of wonderful design with Black pearl plating and simple design. This product provide very comfortable feeling when people hold it with special surface treatment for the grip on a pointer. Time to battery change can be checked with pointer's LED.Magic series has 'Magic Key function' that can change executive command program of button by simple operation. And XPM145 can be used as all powerful remote control by designating hot keys of bookmarks with 'Magic key' function. But the most attractive thing is what solving a problem generated because of different key value on Prezi, Macintosh, Keynote and others.Especially, the color of laser pointer is outstanding. Almost laser color is red. But XPM145 has orange color. It has special Brightness more than two times than normal red laser, also clear pointing is available even at long distances.ChoisTechnology said "Orange color can draw an attention of audience, bright and pleasant presentation is also available "Above these, 'XPM145' is equipped with varied essential functions many function such as Page up/Down, Slide Show, Black screen and others.Meanwhile, ChoisTechnology, leading company of the presentation pointer field with 'X-pointer' Korea brand, now they are selling products to Large stationary Shops, Major retail outlets and Domestic large Shops like Young-poong Bookstore, Kyobo Bookstore, Bandi&Luni's and others. Also they will show 'XPM145' at CES 2012 held in Las Vegas, US from Jan 10-13.
